info.name: AppDynamics Alert and Respond Actions Metrics API
List metric hierarchy for an application

params.name: applicationId
params.description: The numeric ID or name of the business application.

params.name: metric-path
params.description: The metric path to browse. Supports wildcard characters. If not specified, returns the top level of the metric hierarchy.

params.name: output
params.description: The output format for the response. Defaults to XML if not specified.

items.docs: Returns the metric tree hierarchy for the specified application. Use this to discover available metric paths before retrieving metric data. Supports wildcard characters in the metric-path parameter.

info.name: Get metric data for an application

params.name: applicationId
params.description: The numeric ID or name of the business application.

params.name: metric-path
params.description: The full metric path to retrieve data for. Supports wildcard characters using the pipe delimiter for path levels.

params.name: time-range-type
params.description: The type of time range to use for the query.

params.name: duration-in-mins
params.description: Duration in minutes for BEFORE_NOW and BEFORE_TIME time range types.

params.name: start-time
params.description: Start time in Unix epoch milliseconds for AFTER_TIME and BETWEEN_TIMES time range types.

params.name: end-time
params.description: End time in Unix epoch milliseconds for BEFORE_TIME and BETWEEN_TIMES time range types.

params.name: rollup
params.description: When true, aggregates data into a single data point. When false, returns individual data points. Defaults to true.

params.name: output
params.description: The output format for the response. Defaults to XML if not specified.

items.docs: Returns metric data for the specified metric path and time range. The rollup parameter controls whether data is aggregated into a single value or returned as individual data points. Supports wildcard characters in the metric-path parameter.
